scale.note: Domestic-focused. No US retail presence or proprietary crypto custody.

activities.name: Retail and corporate payments
activities.notes: Domestic clearing, SEPA, SWIFT, instant payments, standing orders, salary runs.

controls.name: Four-eyes approval on payment release above threshold
Daily reconciliation of settlement and nostro accounts
Batch job monitoring with duplicate-run detection
